content.description: Illustration showing disconnection of high tension cords from cylinder head and ignition coil, and distributor connector

items: DISCONNECT HIGH TENSION CORDS FROM CYLINDER HEAD AND IGNITION COIL

content.description: Illustration showing removal of distributor set bolt and pulling out distributor from cylinder head

items: PULL OUT DISTRIBUTOR FROM CYLINDER HEAD

content.description: Illustration showing grinding wheel being used to grind drive gear and pin

content.text: Using a grinding wheel, grind the gear and pin.
Be careful not to damage the shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of pin and drive gear using punch and hammer

items: (a) Using a punch and hammer, drive out the pin.
(b) Remove the drive gear and discard it.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of new drive gear and pin using hammer

items: INSTALL NEW DRIVE GEAR AND PIN
(a) Align the marks on the housing and new gear.
(b) Using a hammer, install a new pin.
